name: Antecrocodylus
sum: Middle Miocene crocodile from northern Thailand, recovered as the earliest-diverging member of Crocodylidae.
holotype: CMMC22 — partial skull without the snout, with an associated mandible, Chiang Muan mine, Thailand.
material: The crushed holotype and possibly referable isolated bones from the Mae Moh mine (Na Khaem Formation).
biology: Shows how little is known of the crocodylids of Miocene Asia; it split off before osteolaemines and crocodylines diverged.
author: Martin et al. 2023

sources.text: Martin, J. E.; Naksri, W.; Lauprasert, K.; Wongko, K.; Chompusri, S.; Sila, S.; Claude, J. 2023. An early diverging crocodylid from the Middle Miocene of Thailand highlights the role of SE Asia for the radiation of the Crocodyloidea. Historical Biology 36(12): 2794–2803. doi:10.1080/08912963.2023.2278152
